Person module

Person module providing the base Person class for the School Management System.

This module defines the foundational Person class that serves as the base for both Student and Instructor classes. It includes email validation, age constraints, and common person-related functionality.

class Person.Person(name: str, age: int, email: str)[source]

Bases: object

Base class representing a person in the school management system.

This class provides common functionality for both students and instructors, including email validation, age constraints, and data serialization.

Variables:

  • name (str) – The person’s full name.

  • age (int) – The person’s age in years.

  • __email (str) – The person’s email address (private).
